The '''Begeren system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]].
